_comment: Copy to ~/.bonjour-epta/ai.json and fill in. The real file stays on your machine — corporate hosts and GUIDs never go into git. Without it the corporate-gateway AI buttons stay grey and the translator works as usual. `models` is optional: it replaces the built-in list in the settings picker. The Gemini block below is optional too — the public endpoint is already built in; use it only to override the host/path or pin a default model. The Gemini API key is NOT stored here — paste it in Settings → ИИ-помощник, it is kept encrypted on this PC.

oauth._comment: Only needed for silent token renewal. Omit and the token simply expires.

gemini._comment: Optional overrides for the direct Google AI Studio backend (home use). All fields optional.
